shortDescription: Mosaic announced that Karen A. Swager will retire and resign as Executive Vice President - Operations effective December 1, 2026, and that Walter F. Precourt, III will be appointed Executive Vice President - Operations effective December 1, 2026.Original SEC Filing: MOSAIC CO [ MOS ] - 8-K - Sep. 2…

children: Mosaic announced that Karen A. Swager will retire and resign as Executive Vice President - Operations effective December 1, 2026, and that Walter F. Precourt, III will be appointed Executive Vice President - Operations effective December 1, 2026.
Executive Vice President - Operations; then Senior Advisor
Resignation (to retire); transition to Senior Advisor
Resignation as EVP-Operations effective December 1, 2026; Senior Advisor through retirement in Q2 2027
Effective December 1, 2026 (upon first date of employment in role)
Replaced by Walter F. Precourt, III effective December 1, 2026

Age 62; joined Mosaic in 2009; served as Senior Vice President & Chief Administrative Officer since Nov 1, 2023; prior Mosaic roles include SVP—Strategy and Growth, Phosphates, Potash Operations, and EHS; earlier roles at Holcim (U.S.) and The Dow Chemical Company; B.S. Civil Eng (WPI), M.S. Environmental and Water Resources Eng (Vanderbilt), MBA (UNC-Chapel Hill)
